name: Build APK
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 21
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android
      - name: Create @appdeploy/client shim
        run: |
          mkdir -p node_modules/@appdeploy/client
          cat > node_modules/@appdeploy/client/package.json <<'EOF'
          {"name":"@appdeploy/client","version":"0.0.0","type":"module","main":"index.js"}
          EOF
          cat > node_modules/@appdeploy/client/index.js <<'EOF'
          export const api = {
            async post(path, body) {
              const res = await fetch(path, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(body || {}),
              });
              const raw = await res.text();
              let data = null;
              try { data = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) {}
              if (!res.ok) {
                const err = new Error((data && data.error) || 'Request failed (' + res.status + ')');
                err.response = { status: res.status, data };
                throw err;
              }
              return { data };
            },
          };
          EOF
      - name: Load the deployed app inside the APK
        run: |
          cat > capacitor.config.ts <<'EOF'
          import type { CapacitorConfig } from '@capacitor/cli';
          const config: CapacitorConfig = {
            appId: 'com.budgetbuddy.app',
            appName: 'BudgetBuddy',
            webDir: 'dist',
            server: {
              url: 'https://budget-ael3z9.v2.appdeploy.ai',
              androidScheme: 'https',
              allowNavigation: ['*.appdeploy.ai', '*.supabase.co'],
            },
          };
          export default config;
          EOF
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npx cap add android
      - name: Fix duplicate Kotlin classes
        run: |
          cat >> android/app/build.gradle <<'EOF'

          configurations.all {
              resolutionStrategy {
                  force 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib:1.8.22'
                  force 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk7:1.8.22'
                  force 'org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib-jdk8:1.8.22'
              }
          }
          EOF
      - name: Set BudgetBuddy app icons
        run: |
          RES=android/app/src/main/res
          rm -rf $RES/mipmap-anydpi-v26
          for pair in mdpi:48 hdpi:72 xhdpi:96 xxhdpi:144 xxxhdpi:192; do
            d=${pair%%:*}; s=${pair##*:}
            cp budget-icon-$s.png $RES/mipmap-$d/ic_launcher.png
            cp budget-icon-$s.png $RES/mipmap-$d/ic_launcher_round.png
            cp budget-icon-$s.png $RES/mipmap-$d/ic_launcher_foreground.png
          done
      - run: npx cap sync android
      - run: chmod +x android/gradlew
      - run: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: BudgetBuddy-debug-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
